cues.text: A back alley on the outskirts of Port Island Station, with bins lined up along a wall. Coffins stand upright on the paving, a mist curling around the base of each.
The nearest coffin crumbles away into black smoke. A teenage boy in a cap and jacket stands where it was, and looks around him.
Three strangers walk up and stop in front of him: a pale, shirtless young man with long hair and tattooed arms, a boy in glasses carrying a metal case, and a girl in a long dress.
The boy in glasses sets down his case, opens it and holds up a sheet of paper toward the teenager.
The pale young man walks toward the teenager. The teenager backs away, then turns and runs.
The pale young man raises a revolver high over his head, then levels it at the running boy and fires. The boy falls. The pale young man lowers the gun and tucks it into his jeans.
The pale young man turns his back on the fallen boy.
